facts.business: IEC Education Limited operates in the educational franchise segment but has not carried on any business activity during the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) absence of business activities casting doubt on going concern; (b) internal financial controls not made available; (c) long outstanding Other Financial Assets (Rs 2404.76 Lakhs) and Trade Receivables (Rs 292.15 Lakhs) subject to confirmation/reconciliation; (d) unsubstantiated investments in non-operating subsidiaries (Rs 39.53 Lakhs); (e) unpaid statutory liabilities with unprovided interest/penalties; (f) trade payables (Rs 6.83 Lakhs) subject to confirmation. Key audit matters include unsubstantiated transfer of share application money (Rs 4.60 Lakhs) to capital reserve, write-off of unsecured loan (Rs 168.19 Lakhs) without agreements, reversal of deferred tax asset (Rs 60.18 Lakhs) without documentation, and bad debt write-off (Rs 327.00 Lakhs) without substantiation.

key_risks: Going concern doubt due to absence of business activities
Lack of internal financial controls over financial reporting
Long outstanding financial assets and trade receivables subject to confirmation/reconciliation
Unpaid statutory liabilities with unprovided interest and penalties
Unsubstantiated accounting treatments: transfer to capital reserve, loan write-off, deferred tax reversal, bad debt write-off
Pending arbitration and litigation with Delhi Government over project payments and detained FDR
